propositions: The rebar-brainstorm skill documentation does not explicitly state that blocked/not-yet-claimable tickets have completed the review cycle successfully and require no further agent action until rebar ready resurfaces them.
Agents lack clear guidance prohibiting use of rebar review-plan --force to bypass the claimability fast-fail, leading to repeated forced reviews of blocked tickets that defeat the gate.
Documentation must reinforce that --force is a human-operator-only escape hatch and agents should ask a clarifying question rather than infer authorization from vague instructions.
The plan-review section of SKILL.md must include rationale explaining that forced reviews mint signed attestations against non-final dependencies that silently go stale.
